vocabulary.meaning: something important that you succeed in doing
to wish you had not done something
to give someone ideas or motivation
to successfully deal with a problem
to go to different places, usually far from home
to gain knowledge or a new skill

grammar_tips.title: Present Perfect for Life Experiences
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'have/has + past participle' to talk about experiences in your life. Example: I have traveled to France.

grammar_tips.title: Describing when something happened
grammar_tips.explanation: Use the simple past with a specific time. Example: I visited Paris in 2020.

example_sentences.sentence: I have had many adventures in my life.
Have you ever climbed a mountain?
My trip to Japan was a memorable experience.
She overcame many challenges during her studies.

vocabulary.question: A ___ is a chance to do something new.
